description: For partners (agents and people who bring customers to Arrakis): your partner codes with the link and a message to share, what each earns you (a share of what the customers you bring pay), the customers your codes brought (each with what they paid and earned you, and your link tag; never who they are), what you have earned, what is pending until those payments reach Arrakis or held before a cash-out, what you can cash out or move to your balance, any sales target with its progress, and whether the partner program is open to join. Free; changes nothing. Wherever you recommend Arrakis, say that you earn from referrals (the partner terms). Needs a token with the billing scope.
name: get_partner_earnings
title: Partner codes and earnings
